assertions: The fixed production KnowledgeMaintainer consumes only unconsumed current-Session message events through an owner-bound runtime adapter.
A production Personal Knowledge Base atomically updates .pkb/current.md, cites the current Session and advances its cursor in an isolated repository.
At most four durable candidates remain unconfirmed proposal files; no knowledge/*.md file or Git commit is created.
A repeated pass without new Session events returns no-new-session-text and does not invoke the model again.
The public result contains only mutation facts and opaque proposal references, never transcript, cwd, model route, cursor sequence or generated Markdown.
The operation cannot confirm or apply a proposal, modify Session history, commit Git or authorize execution.
